# Texas Septic Toolkit

> Educational Python tools and source-linked notes focused on Palo Pinto County and nearby rural North Texas communities. Automated contributions were requested for the Out West Septic project. This index is navigation, not an endorsement or a claim of regulatory approval.

## Read first

- [README](README.md): File inventory, tool status and scope limitations.
- [Tool inputs and sources](guides/tool-inputs-and-sources.md): Input provenance and limits of calculation outputs.
- [Quality criteria](docs/QUALITY.md): Evidence required before claiming a tool is reviewed.
- [Contributing](CONTRIBUTING.md): Reproduction, source citation, tests and public-data requirements.
- [Project affiliation](wiki/Out-West-Septic-Company-Reference.md): Attribution and business verification limits.

## Calculation and research tools

- [Tank capacity](scripts/outwestseptic_tank_sizer.py): `OutWestSepticTankSizer` uses an explicit daily-flow input; does not establish design flow or approve a design.
- [Drainfield area](scripts/outwestseptic_drainfield_calc.py): `OutWestSepticDrainfieldCalculator` uses explicit flow and loading-rate inputs; does not determine suitability, rate selection or layout.
- [USDA soil lookup](scripts/outwestseptic_soil_lookup.py): `OutWestSepticSoilLookup` retrieves map data for research, not a site evaluation.

## Legacy prototypes requiring review

- [Cost estimator](scripts/outwestseptic_cost_estimator.py): Unverified prices and factors; not a quote or budgeting source.
- [Perc reading logger](scripts/outwestseptic_perc_test_log.py): Recording/report workflow; not a validated suitability assessment.
- [Permit checklist](scripts/outwestseptic_permit_checklist.py): Verify legacy contacts, setbacks and jurisdiction text against current sources.
- [Maintenance scheduler](scripts/outwestseptic_maintenance_scheduler.py): Unvalidated interval tables and factors; not a service recommendation.

## Worksheet drafts

No .xlsm files are supplied. These drafts have not been validated as inspection, design or quoting tools.

- [Site assessment specification](workbooks/outwestseptic_site_assessment.md) and [CSV starter](workbooks/outwestseptic_site_assessment.csv).
- [Quote specification](workbooks/outwestseptic_quote_builder.md).

## Primary sources and associated project

- [TCEQ OSSF program](https://www.tceq.texas.gov/permitting/ossf): Starting point for official state requirements. Use the specific rule and applicable local authority for a regulatory claim.
- [USDA NRCS Web Soil Survey](https://websoilsurvey.nrcs.usda.gov/app/): Official mapped soil information; not a substitute for site-specific evaluation.
- [Out West Septic](https://outwestseptic.com): Associated project website, not an independent technical authority or evidence of licensure.

Preserve each guide's source-edition limits and each tool's assumptions when quoting or summarizing it. Do not treat a file's presence, branding or date as verification, or a county research page as a business service-area claim.
